descriptions: Batch Time, hour. Elapsed fermentation batch time; Indicator of process stage and biological progression; time feature. Historical online value from the 120-step window preceding the target offline assay; Correlates with all process variable trajectories, Reflects batch progression and phase transitions.

Aeration Rate, L/h. Air supply rate to the fermenter; Controls oxygen supply and gas-liquid mass transfer; control. Historical online value from the 120-step window preceding the target offline assay; Directly affects dissolved oxygen (do2), Influences oxygen uptake rate (our) and CO2 evolution rate (cer), Interacts with agitator speed for mixing and oxygen transfer.

Agitator Speed, rpm. Rotational speed of the agitator; Controls mixing, oxygen transfer, and culture homogeneity; control. Historical online value from the 120-step window preceding the target offline assay; Affects dissolved oxygen (do2) and bulk mixing, Influences mass transfer coefficients together with aeration, Impacts shear stress and microbial morphology.

Sugar Feed Rate, L/h. Rate of sugar solution fed to the fermenter; Supplies carbon substrate for biomass growth and penicillin production; control. Historical online value from the 120-step window preceding the target offline assay; Primary carbon source affecting OUR, CER, and biomass, Influences penicillin synthesis through substrate availability, Feeding rate impacts broth volume and metabolite profiles.

Acid Addition Rate, L/h. Rate of acid addition to the fermenter; Regulates fermentation pH downwards; control. Historical online value from the 120-step window preceding the target offline assay; Directly controls pH together with base additions, Interacts with ammonia shots for pH and nitrogen balance, Affects metabolic activity and enzyme kinetics.

Base Addition Rate, L/h. Rate of base addition to the fermenter; Regulates fermentation pH upwards; control. Historical online value from the 120-step window preceding the target offline assay; Directly controls pH together with acid additions, Interacts with ammonia shots for pH correction, Influences metabolic conditions and solubility of nutrients.

Cooling Water Flow, L/h. Cooling water flow rate through the fermenter jacket; Removes heat to control fermentation temperature; control. Historical online value from the 120-step window preceding the target offline assay; Controls temperature together with heating water, Affects metabolic rates and oxygen solubility, Counteracts metabolic heat generation.

Heating Water Flow, L/h. Heating water flow rate through the fermenter jacket; Adds heat to control fermentation temperature; control. Historical online value from the 120-step window preceding the target offline assay; Controls temperature together with cooling water, Used during initial heating or to maintain minimum temperature, Affects biological kinetics and sensor calibration.

Water-for-Injection Flow, L/h. Flow rate of water-for-injection added to the fermenter; Dilutes broth and adjusts liquid volume; control. Historical online value from the 120-step window preceding the target offline assay; Increases vessel volume and weight, Dilutes nutrient and metabolite concentrations, Can be used to counteract evaporation and sampling losses.

Air Head Pressure, bar. Pressure in the fermenter headspace; Reflects gas supply pressure and vessel headspace condition; observation. Historical online value from the 120-step window preceding the target offline assay; Related to aeration rate and off-gas flow, Influences gas-liquid mass transfer and dissolved gas concentrations, Indicates potential foaming or blockage issues.

Dumped Broth Rate, L/h. Rate of broth removal from the fermenter; Controls fermentation volume and cell retention; control. Historical online value from the 120-step window preceding the target offline assay; Directly reduces vessel volume and weight, Removes biomass, substrate, and product, Part of fed-batch or continuous harvest strategies.

Dissolved Oxygen, mg/L. Concentration of dissolved oxygen in the fermentation broth; Indicates oxygen availability for microbial metabolism; observation. Historical online value from the 120-step window preceding the target offline assay; Affected by aeration, agitation, and OUR, Critical for aerobic metabolism and penicillin production, Low DO may trigger control actions in oxygen supply.

Vessel Volume, L. Liquid volume inside the fermenter; Represents process inventory and dilution state; observation. Historical online value from the 120-step window preceding the target offline assay; Increases with feeds (sugar, PAA, oil, WFI) and decreases with dumped broth, Used to calculate concentrations and yields, Related to weight via broth density.

Vessel Weight, kg. Total weight of the fermenter including liquid and biomass; Alternative online inventory measurement; observation. Historical online value from the 120-step window preceding the target offline assay; Tracks inventory changes similarly to volume, Can detect foaming or density variations, Cross-validates with volume for mass balance.

pH, pH. Acidity or alkalinity of the fermentation broth; Measures biochemical environment critical for enzyme activity and product stability; observation. Historical online value from the 120-step window preceding the target offline assay; Controlled by acid, base, and ammonia shots, Influences metabolic pathways and penicillin synthesis, Deviations can indicate metabolic shifts or contamination.

Temperature, K. Temperature of the fermentation broth; Controls biological reaction rates and enzyme stability; observation. Historical online value from the 120-step window preceding the target offline assay; Controlled by cooling and heating water flows, Affects oxygen solubility, metabolic rates, and product formation, Elevated temperatures can cause thermal stress or protein denaturation.

Outlet CO2 Concentration, %. Concentration of carbon dioxide in the fermenter exhaust gas; Reflects respiration and metabolic activity; observation. Historical online value from the 120-step window preceding the target offline assay; Directly related to CO2 evolution rate (CER), Used with aeration and volume to calculate CER, Indicator of metabolic state and culture health.

PAA Feed Rate, L/h. Flow rate of phenylacetic acid precursor feed; Supplies precursor for penicillin biosynthesis; control. Historical online value from the 120-step window preceding the target offline assay; Essential substrate for penicillin G production, Feeding strategy directly affects penicillin titer, Excess can cause toxicity or waste.

Oil / Antifoam Flow, L/h. Flow rate of oil or antifoam agent added to the fermenter; Controls foam and may serve as carbon source or antifoam; control. Historical online value from the 120-step window preceding the target offline assay; Reduces foam that can block filters or cause pressure issues, Can affect mass transfer and dissolved oxygen, Some oils can be metabolized, influencing OUR and CER.

Oxygen Uptake Rate, g/min. Rate at which cells consume oxygen; Indicates metabolic activity and respiratory intensity; derived. Historical online value from the 120-step window preceding the target offline assay; Derived from gas flow, inlet/outlet O2, and liquid volume, Drives the demand for oxygen transfer from aeration and agitation, Correlates with biomass growth and substrate consumption.

Outlet O2 Concentration, %. Concentration of oxygen in the fermenter exhaust gas; Reflects oxygen transfer and consumption balance; observation. Historical online value from the 120-step window preceding the target offline assay; Used together with inlet O2, aeration, and volume to compute OUR, Low outlet O2 indicates high oxygen uptake or limited transfer, An important signal for aeration and agitation control.

CO2 Evolution Rate, g/h. Rate at which cells produce carbon dioxide; Indicates metabolic activity and respiratory quotient; derived. Historical online value from the 120-step window preceding the target offline assay; Derived from gas flow, outlet CO2, and volume, Reflects metabolic fluxes and culture respiratory state, Used with OUR to calculate respiratory quotient (RQ).

Ammonia Shots, kg. Mass of ammonia added as discrete shots; Provides nitrogen source and assists in pH control; control. Historical online value from the 120-step window preceding the target offline assay; Affects pH and available nitrogen for biomass and product synthesis, Interacts with acid/base control strategy, Pulse additions can cause short-term metabolic shifts.
